name: agentic-organization
//: Root deploy layer only. The website itself lives in site/ (its own package.json); `npm run dev` there for local work. This root wraps `build` + `deploy` so Cloudflare Workers (and one-command local deploys) can build the site and upload site/dist as static assets. See docs/deploy-cloudflare.md.

scripts.build: npm --prefix site install && npm --prefix site run build
scripts.deploy:dashboard: npm run dashboard && wrangler deploy --config apps/dashboard/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check: node scripts/check-freshness.mjs && node scripts/check-workspace.mjs && node scripts/check-fleet.mjs && node scripts/check-packs.mjs && node scripts/check-register.mjs && node scripts/check-access-config.mjs && node scripts/check-leaks.mjs && node scripts/vendor-sync.mjs verify && node scripts/check-retired.mjs
scripts.test: node --test scripts/deck/test.mjs scripts/test-todo.mjs scripts/test-todo-client.mjs scripts/test-access.mjs scripts/test-check-fleet.mjs scripts/test-provenance.mjs scripts/test-open-decisions.mjs scripts/test-register.mjs scripts/test-kit-sync.mjs scripts/test-workspace.mjs scripts/test-hooks.mjs scripts/test-protect-access.mjs scripts/test-contrast.mjs scripts/test-install-workspace.mjs scripts/test-own-changes.mjs scripts/test-workspace-sync.mjs scripts/test-setup-status.mjs scripts/test-check-memory.mjs scripts/test-neighbour.mjs scripts/test-check-leaks.mjs scripts/test-check-access-config.mjs scripts/doc/test.mjs scripts/test-vendor-sync.mjs scripts/test-check-ai-tics.mjs scripts/test-check-retired.mjs && node scripts/test-packs.mjs
scripts.todos:build: npm run todos:sources && npm --prefix apps/todos install && npm --prefix apps/todos run build
scripts.deploy:todos: npm run todos:build && wrangler deploy --config apps/todos/wrangler.jsonc
